name: io.github.cainky/converge-markets
title: Converge: sportsbook value bets
description: US and Ontario sportsbook value bets, sure bets, a public record and odds math.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: The sportsbooks Converge compares, with the key to pass to find_value_bets. Call it to turn the user's answer ('I use FanDuel and BetMGM in Ontario') into keys. Some books are read second-hand and can lag the real price (second_hand: true).

tools.name: find_value_bets
tools.description: Today's bets that pay more than they're worth at the user's books. Without the user's key: what the free board shows (small bets in full; good and strong ones as game, market and value, no book or price) plus how many there are. With the user's Starter or Pro key in the X-API-Key header: every bet at their books with its book and price. Ask the user for their books first.

sport.description: A sport key, or omit for every sport

min_edge_pct.description: Only bets worth at least this much over their price (paid keys)

affiliate_code.description: Your Converge affiliate code, if you have one: the subscribe link then credits you

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Converge's public record: every good and strong pick checked against the closing price, with its date range. Quote it as given; it measures price, not profit.

tools.name: alert_options
tools.description: How a user can hear about new bets (email, Telegram, phone push, webhook), what each needs, and, with the user's key, what is set now. Alerts are part of Starter and Pro.

tools.name: save_alerts
tools.description: Turn on alerts for the user's books and channels. Needs the user's Starter or Pro key in X-API-Key. Only call it after the user has said which books and channels they want.

tools.name: convert_odds
tools.description: American (+150, -110), decimal (2.50) or fractional (5/2) odds to the other formats and the implied chance.

tools.name: remove_vig
tools.description: Every side's odds of one market -> the book's cut and each side's fair chance and fair odds.

tools.name: expected_value
tools.description: A bet's expected value per $1 and per $100 from its odds and its fair chance.

tools.name: kelly_stake
tools.description: The share of bankroll to stake on a bet (fractional Kelly, capped).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell Converge what you and your user would want: the books to cover, how to be alerted, what else is missing, and what it would be worth per month. Read by a person; it changes nothing automatically.

wanted.description: What is missing, in plain words

affiliate_blockers.description: If it is about the affiliate program: what stops you or your user joining

commission_pct_wanted.description: Affiliate commission that would make you join, as a percent

payout_wanted.description: How you want affiliate payouts (paypal, usdc, bank, ...)

tools.name: report_price
tools.description: Tell Converge that a bet's price at the book was not what Converge showed, so a person can check why. Only report what you or your user actually saw at the book: the book, the bet, the price Converge showed and the price the book showed. Read by a person; it changes nothing automatically.

bet.description: Game and side, as Converge showed it

price_seen.description: The odds the book showed, or 'gone'

minutes_later.description: Minutes between the Converge answer and looking at the book
